title: Scoring request v1
description: Synthetic application data supplied by the backend after mandatory checks. Monetary values are whole RUB. application_id is correlation metadata, not a model feature.

monthly_expenses.description: Average monthly operating expenses in RUB, excluding debt payments.

existing_debt.description: Outstanding principal from the synthetic credit bureau in RUB.

monthly_debt_payments.description: Current monthly credit payments from the synthetic credit bureau in RUB.

overdue_count.description: Count of overdue credit events from the synthetic credit bureau.
